description: Close (cancel) open offers and reclaim the locked funds. Returns null on success. Always closes expired offers automatically, even if no parameters are given. When specific offer txids are provided, closes only those offers. Use this to cancel offers that are no longer wanted, or as periodic cleanup to reclaim funds from expired offers.

destination.description: Transparent or private address to send reclaimed funds to.

privatefundsdestination.description: Private (Sapling) address for native funds only.

txids.description: Array of offer transaction IDs to close. If omitted, closes all expired offers.

name: closeoffers
